title: Scaling Full Conformal Image Classifiers
abstract: arXiv:2609.37298v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conformal prediction provides set-valued predictions with distribution-free coverage guarantees, making it attractive for high-stakes image classification. However, split conformal prediction is data-inefficient, while full conformal prediction (FCP), despite its stronger statistical efficiency, is computationally prohibitive at scale because it requires candidate-specific model refits at test time. We address this limitation by leveraging zero-shot vision-language models (VLMs) to guide scalable FCP in large label spaces. We introduce Targeted Full Conformal Prediction (T-FCP), which uses a lightweight inductive conformal predictor to prune unlikely labels and applies FCP only to the remaining candidates, reducing computation while retaining the formal guarantee of the combined conformal procedure. We further propose Stabilized Online LDA (SO-LDA), an efficient VLM adaptation solver based on rank-one inverse-covariance updates. Across m

translated_title: 扩展全共形图像分类器
translated_abstract: 共形预测通过提供具有无分布覆盖保证的集合值预测，使其在高风险图像分类任务中极具吸引力。然而，分割共形预测的数据效率较低，而全共形预测（FCP）尽管具有更强的统计效率，但在大规模应用时计算代价极高，因为它需要在测试时针对每个候选标签重新拟合模型。为了解决这一局限，我们利用零样本视觉-语言模型（VLM）来引导可扩展的FCP在大规模标签空间中的应用。我们提出了目标全共形预测（T-FCP），它使用轻量级的归纳共形预测器对不太可能的标签进行剪枝，并仅对剩余的候选标签应用FCP，在保留组合共形过程形式化保证的同时降低了计算量。我们进一步提出了稳定化在线LDA（SO-LDA），这是一种基于秩一逆协方差更新的高效VLM适配求解器。
tldr: 该论文提出了目标全共形预测（T-FCP），通过轻量级归纳共形预测器剪枝候选标签，并结合基于秩一逆协方差更新的稳定化在线LDA（SO-LDA）来适配视觉-语言模型，使全共形预测在大规模标签空间的图像分类中计算可行且保留形式化覆盖保证。
en_tdlr: We introduce Targeted Full Conformal Prediction (T-FCP), which prunes unlikely labels with a lightweight inductive conformal predictor and adapts VLMs via Stabilized Online LDA (SO-LDA), making full conformal prediction computationally feasible for large-scale image classification while retaining formal coverage guarantees.
